t: Star Trek: Voyager: Heroes And Demons
d: Janeway sends the ship's doctor on his first Away Mission: rescue the crew members who have vanished in the holodeck’s version of Beowulf.
Harry Mudd (Rainn Wilson), back to his old tricks of stealing and double-dealing, finds himself in a precarious position aboard a hostile ship - just in time to try out his latest con.
Newly minted Captain Lynne Lucero is excited to take command of the U.S.S.Cabot, until she meets Edward Larkin, an ornery scientist who believes he has found a revolutionary new use for tribbles.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: A Man Alone
d: Odo must prove his innocence when a known enemy of his is found brutally murdered in a Holosuite.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Babel
d: A deadly virus sweeps over Deep Space Nine, and it is up to Kira to find an antidote.

t: Star Trek: Voyager: Time And Again
d: When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.
Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.
Cyrano Jones returns, along with new tribbles that can't multiply.
The Enterprise finds missing trader and philanthropist Carter Winston, but he may not be what he appears to be.
Kirk and the crew are faced with a race of intelligent plants and a mad scientist who wants to impose peace on the galaxy.
The Enterprise goes to the center of the galaxy, where they find a race of powerful aliens who once fled Earth.

An Enterprise away-team fights delusions and paranoid suspicions caused by an alien wildflower's hallucinogenic pollen while stranded overnight to wait out a violent windstorm on a beautiful unexplored planet.
While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

The first to see the lost human colony of Terra Nova in over seventy-five years, Archer and the Enterprise crew discover the original colonists descendants have evolved into an underground race called Novans.
Ephraim, a humble tardigrade, is flying through the mycelial network when an unexpected encounter takes her on a bewildering adventure through space.

st: The Girl Who Made the Stars
d: When a lightning storm in space scares a young Michael Burnham, her father aims to ease her fears with a mythical story about a brave little girl who faced her own fears head on.
12-year-old classmates Kima and Lil find themselves at odds with each other on a day that will change their lives forever.
Kapten Tasha Yar slåss för sin frihet, efter att ha kidnappats av ligonier, och för välståndet på en sjuk federationsplanet.
Utgrupperna från Enterprise och ferengirymdskepp hålls fångna över en okänd planet och måste klara en viktig utfrågning från en mystisk livsform benämnd Portal.

st: Where No One Has Gone Before
d: Tonåringen Wesley Crusher och en döende främling är besättningens enda hopp att fly från en bisarr galax där tankar blir verklighet.
